Ashish Kumar ashish619123@gmail.com | +91 6382261169 | linkedin.com/in/ashish-kumar-870739184 | Bangalore, India

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer and ServiceNow Certified System Administrator with 4.9 years of experience across Development and Implementation, including ITSM (Incident, Problem, Change, Service Catalog), CSM, HRSD, and CMDB. Skilled in Platform Administration, Flow Designer, Automated Test Framework (ATF), REST API integrations, and Agile/Scrum delivery. Recent focus on applying AI agents and custom LLMs to accelerate ServiceNow migrations and configuration validation, cutting migration effort by up to 80% while maintaining data accuracy and stakeholder alignment.

EXPERIENCE

Exemietas Design Pvt Ltd — Senior Developer • Designed and implemented AI agents and custom LLMs to accelerate ServiceNow migrations, reducing timelines from

Aug 2025 – Present

months to days.

Automated the ITSM module using AI-driven workflows, enabling seamless onboarding and configuration for customers. • Worked with CSM, CMDB to support customer service processes, configuration item data integrity, and discovery-driven service mapping.

Leveraged generative AI to simplify process mapping, data migration, and configuration validation, ensuring accuracy and reducing manual effort.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate AI-powered automation pipelines, improving scalability and customer adoption.

Delivered measurable impact by cutting migration effort by 80%, enhancing customer satisfaction, and positioning Digital Force as a leader in rapid ServiceNow transformation.

Guide House India Pvt Ltd — Technical Associate • Developed and customized ITSM, HRSD, and Service Catalog modules in ServiceNow, including catalog items, order

May 2022 – Aug 2025

guides, and record producers.

Built and optimized workflows and Flow Designer flows, automating approvals, assignments, and complex business processes.

Designed and implemented Business Rules, Client Scripts, and UI Policies using Glide scripting to enhance platform functionality.

Configured and managed SLA workflows for advanced service level tracking. •

Integrated external systems via REST APIs, import sets, and data loads, ensuring seamless data migration and synchronization.

Streamlined configuration management by creating and merging update sets, reducing deployment errors. • Delivered custom applications and UI components, improving user experience and organizational efficiency. • Recognized with multiple awards for adaptability, customer centricity, and collaboration.

SITEL India Pvt Ltd — ServiceNow Developer Aug 2021 – May 2022 • Gained 8 months of experience with expertise in the ITSM module, focusing on Incident, Problem, and Change. • Maintained the quality of web-based applications using ServiceNow. • Experience in workflows, maintaining and writing client- and server-side scripts. • Attended daily scrum calls, collaborating with Product Owners and onsite counterparts.

AWARDS AND APPRECIATIONS

Appreciated with a Kudos award for Q2-2022 for highlighting agile values, being an adaptive learner, and adapting to change.

Appreciated with a Values award for Q3-2022. • Received appreciation from Client & Management teams.

CERTIFICATIONS

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) — Rome Delta Exam • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) • Micro Certification: ATF Fundamentals • Micro Certification: Flow Designer • Lead II Certified — Leadership program covering Planning & Prioritization, Customer Centricity, Creative Thinking, Working in Virtual Teams, and Preventing Escalations

ACADEMIC DETAILS

2017–21 — B.Tech. in Computer Science & Engineering, Dr MGR Educational and Research Institute, Chennai — 7.92 CGPA

2016–17 — H.S.C, Jain Vidyaashram School (CBSE), Chennai — 61% • 2013–14 — S.S.C, Jain Vidyaashram School (CBSE), Chennai — 8.2 GPA

TECHNICAL SKILLS

ServiceNow Modules: ITSM, CSM, HRSD, Service Catalog, Asset Management, SAM, CMDB

ITSM Processes: Incident, Problem, Change, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, SLA Management

Platform Administration: Users, Groups, Roles, Update Set Management, Instance Configuration, Automated Test Framework (ATF)

Automation & AI: AI Agents, Custom LLMs, Generative AI workflows, Flow Designer

Scripting & Development: JavaScript, Glide Script (server/client), Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies

Integration & APIs: REST APIs, Import Sets, Data Migration, Update Sets

Platform Expertise: CMDB, Notifications, Custom Application Development, UI Components

Collaboration Tools: Agile/Scrum/Kanban practices, Daily Standups, User Stories, Cross-functional teamwork
